cohort: Referred obstetric patients over 20 weeks gestation at a tertiary care hospital in Mumbai, India, from January 2020 to December 2020.
finding: Of the referred patients, the most common referral indications were meconium-stained amniotic fluid/fetal distress (19.4%) and preterm labor (11.1%), with high rates of cesarean delivery (77.4%), maternal morbidity (16.6%), and NICU admission (14.3%).
